_comment: Golden fixture for the NN actor-critic update rule. Generated by tools/gen_nn_golden.py; regenerating must be a deliberate act -- a diff here means the update rule's numerics changed.

scenarios.name: ach_shipped_layernorm
scenarios.why: The shipped ACH default: raw-logit gate + raw-logit loss body on a LayerNorm torso (docs/reproduce_report.md 6.5).

scenarios.name: ach_pre_layernorm_centered
scenarios.why: Pre-LayerNorm behavior: both gate and loss body on the mean-centered logit, no torso LayerNorm.

scenarios.name: ach_legal_only_mean
scenarios.why: A5 probe path: y_bar averaged over legal actions only, with a batch that actually has illegal actions.

scenarios.name: ach_grad_clipped
scenarios.why: Grad-clipping branch (max_grad_norm > 0) on the ACH side.

scenarios.name: ppo_legacy_adam
scenarios.why: Reference PPO exactly as it shipped pre-merge: Adam(eps=1e-5) + advantage normalization + clip 0.2 + grad clip 0.5. Adam carries optimizer state, so 3 steps also pin the moment buffers.

scenarios.name: ppo_on_ach_scaffolding
scenarios.why: PPO loss under the ACH scaffolding (SGD, raw advantages, no grad clip) -- the theta=0 arm of the scan, and the new PPO default.
